sets.title: Invoice total calculator with numeric literal thresholds modified
sets.description: The same invoice line-item totalling method in three calculator classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B changes 1-2 numeric literals (threshold 100→150); carrier C changes every numeric literal (threshold 100→200, shipping 9.99→12.99). Structure and layout are byte-identical — only numeric literals differ (Type-2), so identifier-canonicalizing token tools, AST, metric and semantic detectors should still match all three.
sets.notes: Only numeric literals are changed (LT-01); carrier B changes 1-2 numerics, carrier C changes all. Pristine (A) vs fully-changed (C) is the discriminating pair.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice calculation vocabulary and foreach-over-items shape, but computes a histogram of line item prices — a different result
